# telnyx_messaging_hosted_number_orders (Data Source)

Lists messaging hosted number orders, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_messaging_hosted_number_order`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `messaging_hosted_number_orders` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messaging_hosted_number_orders))

### Nested Schema for `messaging_hosted_number_orders`

- `id` (String) Resource unique identifier.
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Automatically associate the number with this messaging profile ID when the order is complete.
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messaging_hosted_number_orders--phone_numbers))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
